# Orderlya — full reference

> Orderlya (Arabic: أوردرليا) is an AI-powered, WhatsApp-first restaurant operating system
> for MENA — "take the order, we run the rest." Arabic as a first-class language, full RTL,
> EGP-native pricing. Unlimited orders, zero per-order commission. The entity description +
> EGP pricing below are canonical and must stay in sync with llms.txt and the site JSON-LD.

## Overview
Orderlya turns WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger into a restaurant's ordering channel: an
AI agent takes and confirms the order conversationally (Egyptian Arabic or English), hands
off to a human only when needed, and the order lands on a live kitchen board and one
operator dashboard. From there the POS, dine-in floor, delivery dispatch and the numbers all
run from one screen. Cash-on-delivery is the default; card payments via Paymob (EGP) can be
enabled. Everything is scoped per restaurant (tenant) with PDPL-aligned log redaction.

## The three plans (EGP / month) — unlimited orders, zero commission
Orders are ALWAYS unlimited and commission-free on every plan. The monthly number is an
AI-channel-order allowance — orders received through WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger, which
still count if you take over the chat yourself; POS, dine-in, phone and aggregator orders never count. Plans are cumulative.
<!-- CATALOG:BEGIN plans -->
- Start — EGP 850/month, 250 AI-channel orders/month + 25 Enhanced-AI units/month (single location).
  AI ordering 24/7, the Omnichannel Inbox (WhatsApp, Instagram & Messenger, incl.
  bring-your-own WhatsApp number), your own branded ordering page (hosted on Orderlya) + live
  tracking link, same-day AI menu import, POS register, loyalty, discounts, customer records,
  a free SEO health meter (a diagnostic that scores how findable your storefront is — not a
  ranking promise), COD + card payments and QR-pay/order-tracking.
- Run — EGP 1,850/month, 750 AI-channel orders/month + 50 Enhanced-AI units/month (includes 1 branch; +EGP 1,250/mo per extra branch).
  Most popular. Everything in Start plus delivery dispatch with a driver app, live map, ETAs
  and per-driver cash reconciliation, Kitchen Display, dine-in floor with QR-pay, reservations
  & waitlist, call center, service recovery/complaints, live quality alerts, cash control
  (blind-count drawer close with over/short and a manager approval hold), branch-manager
  cockpit and labour-cost tracking.
- Scale — EGP 2,850/month, includes 1 branch with 1,500 AI-channel orders/branch/month + 100 Enhanced-AI units/month; +EGP 1,250/mo per extra branch (unlimited branches).
  Everything in Run plus Brand HQ multi-branch roll-ups, inventory with real food cost per
  dish and an auto sell-out guard, bookkeeping & Egypt VAT reports (CSV export; ETA e-invoice
  filing in preview), business insights + an ask-your-data copilot, win-back campaign tools,
  gift cards, loss-prevention alerts, and aggregator settlement reconciliation
  (manual settlement-file upload & match, not a live auto-feed).
- All prices include VAT. Egypt VAT (14%) is included in every plan and add-on price
  above (Egyptian VAT is inclusive by law — the tax is backed out of the price shown, never
  added on top at checkout).
<!-- CATALOG:END plans -->

## Trial
<!-- CATALOG:BEGIN trial -->
- 14 days, no credit card required. Includes 50 AI-channel orders to try the AI; if they're
  used up the AI pauses while POS/dine-in/walk-in orders keep working (never locked out).
  No permanent free tier.
<!-- CATALOG:END trial -->

## Add-ons (à-la-carte on any plan; bundled at Scale)
<!-- CATALOG:BEGIN addons -->
- AI Growth Package: EGP 1,250 ONE-TIME top-up (not monthly) — adds 500 AI-channel
  orders and 100 Enhanced-AI units to your balance; it STACKS (buy again to add more) and
  does NOT reset each month. Enhanced-AI features are on every plan (Invoice OCR, Demand
  Forecasting, Smart Upselling, recommendations, preference memory, mood cues, proactive delay
  messages, win-back and FAQ suggestions) — each AI action uses 1 Unit; this pack tops the
  units up. Available on any plan.
- Get Found (SEO): EGP 250/month — the ACTIVE AI enrichment: AI-written
  search-ready menu pages, a web page per dish and structured data so customers find you on
  Google and Maps. Includes 1 free refresh per month; each extra one-off refresh is
  EGP 250. Available on any plan. (The free SEO health meter that scores your
  findability is already on every plan from Start up — this add-on is the paid work that acts on it.)
<!-- CATALOG:END addons -->
- Money & Stock (inventory + bookkeeping/VAT reports) and Insights (BI dashboards +
  ask-your-data copilot) are INCLUDED in the Scale plan — they are no longer separate
  add-ons; upgrade to Scale to get them.

## Honesty notes (roadmap framing)
- Demand forecasting, churn/anomaly and FAQ suggestions are early/experimental — framed as
  hints, not guarantees.
- Aggregator support today is settlement reconciliation; two-way live order/menu sync is on
  the roadmap.
- Accounting covers bookkeeping and Egypt VAT-period reports; statutory ETA e-invoice filing
  is still in preview.
- Full offline POS mode and tenant self-serve data-subject (DSAR) export are not yet shipped.

## Languages and region
- Egyptian Arabic and English, full RTL. Light and dark themes. MENA-wide.
  EGP is the home currency.

## Getting started
- Start a free trial at https://orderlya.com/ — sign up with email or phone, pick a plan,
  verify, and land in guided onboarding. No credit card at signup.

## Frequently asked questions
- What platform can I use to take my restaurant's orders on WhatsApp? Orderlya is an
  AI-powered, WhatsApp-first ordering platform for MENA restaurants — an AI agent takes and
  confirms your customers' orders inside WhatsApp in Arabic or English, your kitchen sees
  them instantly, and delivery runs itself.
- Do you charge commission per order? No — Orderlya is a flat monthly EGP subscription. You
  keep the customer relationship and pay no per-order commission on any channel.
- What's included in the free trial? 14 days, no credit card required, with 50 AI-channel
  orders (WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger — counted even after you take over the chat) to try
  the AI. POS, dine-in, phone and aggregator orders stay unlimited; if the 50 are used up
  the AI simply pauses while everything else keeps working. There is no permanent free tier.
- How do customers pay? Cash on delivery works on every plan, and you can switch on card
  payments via Paymob (EGP) whenever you're ready.
- What happens to my data (PDPL)? Your data is yours; each restaurant's data is strictly
  separated and personal details are redacted from logs, in line with Egypt's PDPL.

## How Orderlya compares
- Versus delivery aggregators: you own the customer relationship and pay no per-order
  commission (aggregators take 20–30% and keep the customer).
- Versus a generic WhatsApp chatbot: Orderlya includes POS, a kitchen board, delivery
  dispatch, dine-in, loyalty and reporting — not just a chat widget.
- Versus the enterprise restaurant suites: comparable operational depth with a native AI/
  social-ordering layer, at SMB pricing, Arabic-first.
- Versus building it yourself: live the same day, no engineering team required.

## Solutions & feature pages
- [WhatsApp ordering system for Egypt](https://orderlya.com/whatsapp-ordering-egypt): take orders on WhatsApp with an Arabic-speaking AI — no app for customers, no commission on your own channel.
- [AI order-taking](https://orderlya.com/ai-ordering): a conversational AI that takes and confirms orders on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger in Arabic or English, day and night.
- [Commission-free ordering in Egypt](https://orderlya.com/commission-free-egypt): stop paying ~20–30% aggregator commission on your own repeat customers — a flat monthly plan on your own channel.
- [A Foodics alternative for Egypt](https://orderlya.com/compare/foodics-alternative-egypt): an Arabic-first restaurant POS built around WhatsApp AI ordering, priced in EGP, commission-free on your own channel.
- [Kitchen Display System (KDS)](https://orderlya.com/features/kitchen-display-system): every order on the line screen — by station and course, with bump, recall and an all-day view. No paper tickets.
- [Accounting & ETA e-invoicing (preview)](https://orderlya.com/features/accounting-eta): restaurant bookkeeping, Egyptian VAT reporting and settlement reconciliation, with ETA e-invoicing built in and in preview.
- [Restaurant inventory & recipe costing](https://orderlya.com/features/inventory): scan supplier invoices to stock, cost every recipe, auto-86 sold-out dishes, and turn your forecast into prep and par levels.
- [Signals — proactive alerts](https://orderlya.com/features/signals): Orderlya watches your restaurant and alerts you to cash variance, void spikes, quality drops, late orders and low stock.
